hints: Use trigonometry in $\triangle OCD$ to find lengths $CD$ and $OD$.
Calculate $BD = r - OD$ and arc length $CB = r\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)$, then sum all three boundaries.
walkthrough:
Determine angle $\angle COB$ in radians:
$$\angle COB = \angle AOB - \angle AOC = \frac{\pi}{2} - \theta$$

Find the side lengths $CD$ and $OD$ in the right-angled triangle $OCD$:
$$CD = r \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = r \cos\theta$$
$$OD = r \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = r \sin\theta$$

Find length $BD$ and arc length $CB$:
$$BD = OB - OD = r - r \sin\theta$$
$$\text{Arc } CB = r \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)$$

Sum the boundary lengths to express the perimeter $P$:
$$P = CD + BD + \text{Arc } CB = r\cos\theta + r - r\sin\theta + r\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = r\left(1 + \cos\theta - \sin\theta + \frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Finds $CD = r\cos\theta$ and $BD = r - r\sin\theta$ (B1B1). Finds arc $CB = r(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta)$ (B1). Obtains full perimeter $P = r\cos\theta + r - r\sin\theta + r(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta)$ (B1).

skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Notice that shaded area = $\text{Area of sector } COB - \text{Area of } \triangle OCD$.
Calculate triangle area using $\frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2}(5\sin 0.6)(5\cos 0.6)$ and subtract.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of sector $COB$ with radius $r = 5\text{ cm}$ and central angle $\frac{\pi}{2} - 0.6$:
$$\text{Area of sector } COB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0.6\right) = \frac{1}{2}(5^2)\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0.6\right) = 12.5 \times 0.97080 \approx 12.135\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of the right-angled triangle $OCD$:
$$\text{Area of } \triangle OCD = \frac{1}{2} (r\sin 0.6)(r\cos 0.6) = 12.5 \times 0.56464 \times 0.82534 \approx 5.825\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the area of $\triangle OCD$ from the area of sector $COB$:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 12.135 - 5.825 = 6.31\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Calculates sector area $= 12.135$ (M1). Calculates triangle area $= 5.825$ (M1). Obtains shaded area $= 6.31\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).
